_comment: Emote lines for Oni (the hunting cat) — complete sentences, shown in the chat log exactly as written. Categories: hail (player hails her), engage (she spots a rat), banter (occasional idle behavior). Add or edit freely.
hail: Oni glances at you, then back toward the dunes, tail twitching.
Oni gives you a slow, unimpressed blink and goes back to watching for rats.
Mrrp! Oni pads over, sniffs your boots, and decides you are acceptable.
engage: Oni's ears flatten as she spots a rat and slinks low to the ground.
Oni's tail lashes once. Something squeaked.
Oni crouches, haunches wiggling, and springs into the hunt!
banter: Oni sits down and washes one paw with great seriousness.
Oni stretches, yawns, and looks around for something to pounce on.
Oni sniffs the air, whiskers twitching.
Oni watches a distant rat with narrow, patient eyes.
